name: BAKI
description: While martial arts champion Baki Hanma trains hard to surpass his legendary father, five violent death row inmates descend upon Tokyo to take him on.

videos.title: Synchronicity
videos.overview: Underground martial arts promoter Tokugawa warns champion Baki that five violent death row escapees from around the world are all heading for Tokyo.

videos.title: Dark Martial Arts
videos.overview: While Baki easily subdues the thugs hired by delinquents from his own school, death row escapee Spec pays a visit to assess the champion's abilities.

videos.title: They're Finally Here!!
videos.overview: Death row escapee Dorian barges into the Shinshinkai Dojo and is confronted by Sea King Retsu, who's there coaching students in Chinese martial arts.

videos.title: The Battle Begins
videos.overview: With all five death row escapees and their opponents assembled inside the underground arena, Tokugawa officially declares the beginning of battle.

videos.title: Want some more?
videos.overview: While out with Kozue, Baki is almost ambushed by Spec, but he' s spared a fight when Kaoru suddenly appears to protect the couple from harm's way.

videos.title: Sergeant Katahira’s Report
videos.overview: Spec unleashes moves lethal enough to take out even the strongest of opponents in one strike, but Hanayama counters with improbable moves of his own.

videos.title: A Formidable Team
videos.overview: Ambushed by Doyle while in class, Baki leads Doyle away from the classroom only to encounter Yanagi in disguise outside.

videos.title: A Match vs. A True Fight
videos.overview: While Baki and his allies discuss the events that transpired at his school, Dorian appears, infiltrating Tokugawa's heavily guarded compound.

videos.title: Shaken Shinshinkai
videos.overview: Kiyosumi Kato, known as one of the strongest fighters of Shinshinkai Karate, confronts Dorian deep inside his secret underground hideout.

videos.title: Air Duel
videos.overview: Boasting one million members nationwide, the Shinshinkai lures Dorian to an amusement park, where Kato's peer Suedo immediately strikes.

videos.title: Tiger Slayer
videos.overview: As Dorian's past comes to light, Shinshinkai founder and "tiger killer" Doppo Orochi takes him on in an all-out karate versus kempo battle.

videos.title: Candy
videos.overview: Doppo Orochi pummels the life out of terror-stricken Dorian before bringing the equally injured Kiyosumi Kato over to administer the finishing blows.

videos.title: Mr. Oliva
videos.overview: Biscuit Oliva arrives in Tokyo to capture the remaining convicts. Sikorsky lures Baki into battle with help from an unlikely source.

videos.title: Unforgivable Freedom
videos.overview: While searching the police database for clues, an unsuspecting Biscuit Oliva is ambushed by Doyle, who shows up dressed as a female police officer.

videos.title: Tremendous Muscle Power
videos.overview: While searching the police database for clues, an unsuspecting Biscuit Oliva is ambushed by Doyle, who shows up dressed as a female police officer.

videos.title: Slash
videos.overview: Biscuit Oliva thinks he should get a black belt if he can score a point against every officer on the judo team, but Sonoda resists giving him one.

videos.title: Dad!!
videos.overview: The deadly fight between Kosho Shinogi and Doyle reaches its spectacular climax. Meanwhile, Yujiro pays a visit to an unsuspecting Baki and Kozue.

videos.title: Thanks
videos.overview: Known as the pinnacle master of Chinese martial arts, Sea King Retsu displays his masterful use of weaponry against a fully armed Hector Doyle.

videos.title: Admission of Defeat
videos.overview: After setting off an explosion inside Shinshinkai's dojo, Doyle is confronted by its founder, Doppo. Tokugawa pays a visit to Ryukoh Yanagi's master.

videos.title: Saga
videos.overview: Tokugawa learns of the Poison Hand: the ultimate killer move of the "kudo" martial art form. Baki takes the next step in his relationship with Kozue.

videos.title: Punishment
videos.overview: A newly invigorated Baki easily handles attacks from both Ryukoh Yanagi and Sikorsky, but before finishing them off, Baki makes an unusual move.

videos.title: Clash of the Alphas
videos.overview: Baki's half-brother Jack Hammer challenges Sikorsky at a local park, where a battle inside the most inconceivable of places goes down.

videos.title: The Real Attack
videos.overview: Sikorsky is brought inside an unground battle arena to face Gaia, whose unorthodox fighting method slowly wears out the ruthless Russian killer.

videos.title: Defeat
videos.overview: With Ryukoh Yanagi's poison hand no longer a threat, Yujiro Hanma urges him to admit defeat against the sword-wielding jujutsu fighter Izo Motobe.

videos.title: God and the Devil
videos.overview: Legendary world heavyweight boxing champion Arai reflects on his tense encounter with a young Yujiro Hanma.

videos.title: The Centennial Tournament
videos.overview: Retsu pleads with his mentor, Sea King Ryu, to grant a mortally poisoned Baki special entry into the Raitai martial arts tournament.

videos.title: Begin! The Centennial Tournament
videos.overview: Mohammad Alai Jr. tests a battle-eager Yujiro. Even though he's been poisoned, Sea King Retsu enters Baki into the Great Raitai Tournament in China.

videos.title: Turnaround
videos.overview: Alai Jr.'s deadly speed makes quick work of his opponent. A severely emaciated Baki faces Sea King Li, the greatest Poison Hand user in all of China.

videos.title: Revived!
videos.overview: Sea Emperor Kaku is 121 years older than his opponent, but the legendary reigning champion doesn't hesitate to face Sea King Samwan in the arena.

videos.title: Team Formed!
videos.overview: Sea King Chin and Japan's sole Sea King, Jaku, battle on the tournament floor. Meanwhile, Baki provokes Yujiro into fighting him offstage.

videos.title: Hand Pocket
videos.overview: Biscuit Oliva's sheer power is unrivaled, but Shobun Ron and his unconventional fighting stance are unbothered. It's brute strength versus iai kenpo.

videos.title: Excellennnnt!
videos.overview: A genius of Chinese kenpo, Retsu is the superior fighter, but Jaku's dirty techniques and tactical prowess make him a formidable foe.

videos.title: Kaioh
videos.overview: Sea Emperor Kaku is the embodiment of Chinese kenpo. Yujiro Hanma is known as the strongest creature on Earth. A battle unlike any other begins!

videos.title: The Title of the Strongest
videos.overview: Yujiro pits his raw power against Kaku's martial arts skills, which he's honed for over a century. The match's shocking outcome stuns everyone.

videos.title: The Master vs the Boxer
videos.overview: Alai Jr. proposes to Kozue, who's dumbfounded. To prove he's a better man than Baki, Alai Jr. challenges the elderly aikido master Goki Shibukawa.

videos.title: Stand and Fight
videos.overview: Alai Jr. continues testing his skill against notable fighters, but Baki's half-brother Jack Hammer is unlike any combatant he's faced before.

videos.title: Awakening
videos.overview: Badly injured from his street fights, Alai Jr. returns to his hotel room. There his father, the greatest boxer of all time, challenges him to a match.

videos.title: Completion
videos.overview: A battle between the sons of two legendary fighters begins deep below Tokyo Dome. It’s Baki versus Alai Jr., and the winner is anyone's guess.

videos.title: Revenge Tokyo
videos.overview: After Ryukoh Yanagi escapes from prison, Inspector Sonoda attempts to locate the other death row inmates who wreaked havoc on Tokyo.
